# `morphir mck package inspect`

- **Usage:** `morphir mck package inspect <--source <DIR>> <--contract <VERSION>>`

Inspect draft.3 candidate definitions and pending assets without running restore

## Flags
- **`--source <DIR>`** — Repository root containing spec/package and its referenced schemas and assets
- **`--contract <VERSION>`** — Candidate-definition contract to inspect

  **Choices:** `0.1.0-draft.3`
